charges.label: Weight component
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

document_rules.rule: An invoice line whose consignment-note (c-note) number cannot be matched to a Customer booking is not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; each credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Payment is due 21 days from invoice date. Invoices are issued as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly.

notes: No ambiguities found: the contract fully and literally specifies the freight formula (₹6/kg weight component + ₹2/km distance component), the sole accessorial (20% cold-chain premium on the summed freight charge), and that only standard service is offered. special_handling values 'fragile' and 'residential' are named nowhere in the contract, so no charge attaches to them (this is not an ambiguity, simply an absence of a matching clause). No tiered rate card, minimum weight, or declared-value-based charge is present.
